## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Content or documentation
- [ ] Accessibility or privacy improvement
- [ ] Maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] I tested the affected path at desktop and mobile widths
- [ ] I tested keyboard-only interaction when the interface changed
- [ ] I verified both light and dark themes when visual styles changed
- [ ] I preserved the scoring invariants or documented an approved change
- [ ] I added no analytics, tracking, external scripts, or unintended data transmission

## Evidence and notes

Add screenshots, recordings, test output, or reviewer context. Explain any unchecked validation item.
